title: The Riot
summary: The Deep stops giving slabs eleven days after the wall went loud: the Vein closed over the bite. Rennick's weight count collapses; Tullus sets fourteen by the piece and sends Sabinus to the Deep, where he harvests diggers through the neck seam for slabs that will not come. Auger decides to take the cage at the fourth bell to force Tullus to talk, asks decury six to stay behind the wall, and asks Jonah to keep Decimus off the road. Jonah does not warn Decimus. The road takes the cage; Sabinus comes down it harvesting; Jonah sees the water step and knows he would last two seconds. A Collar brings a chisel down on Decimus; Jonah crosses the road unplated, pulls the man through, and hauls Decimus under a shelf. Auger meets Sabinus, feints at the feint, and puts a finger of Bricks's chisel into the armpit seam; Sabinus hurries and opens him. Fear of the seam on the Centurion's face. In the dark of a cut two young guards come for Jonah: full plate, the throat seam, a half of the water step, the armpit seam. He refuses to let the genius eat them because Sabinus would smell it. The plate goes in clean: the seam is a scar now. Strain: about twenty-six. Tullus comes down, lines forty-one men, and Rennick touches every tenth. The tenth falls on Jonah; Tullus reads the Censor's slate and says 'not that one'; the hand moves to Corr. Hollen, Bricks, Corr and two others go to the post and it is not the post. The Censor: he sold the galleries' numbers to save Jonah, knowing a tenth man is a tenth man; and then the rest: he drew the Pit. The Throat, the road, the Cradle, this room. Jonah says the names on the road and cannot say the first one, and does not go back for six weeks.

events.description: The Deep stops giving slabs eleven days after the loud night; the Vein closed over the bite. Rennick's count collapses to nine; Tullus calls one count a lie, sets fourteen by the piece, sends Sabinus to the Deep.
Sabinus harvests four diggers at the face through the neck seam for slabs that will not come. The post returns to the Shallows daily; a decury that makes eight loses a man. Fifty-nine on the road.

Auger tells Jonah the plan: the cage at the fourth bell, hold the road and the Throat's bottom so Tullus must talk; six stays behind the wall; keep Decimus off the road. Jonah counts it and does not warn Decimus.
The road takes the cage. Sabinus comes down harvesting with six guards. Jonah sees the water step and knows he would last two seconds.
A Collar brings a chisel down on Decimus at the cage end; Jonah crosses the road unplated, pulls the man through, chisels his thigh, hauls Decimus under a shelf. 'It's not personal.'

Auger meets Sabinus, feints at the feint, and puts a finger of Bricks's ground chisel into the armpit seam. Sabinus hurries, opens him shoulder to hip. Fear of the seam on the Centurion's face. 'Next.'

In the dark of a cut, two young Tiro guards come for Jonah with a lamp: full plate, the crooked fang through the throat seam, half a water step, the armpit seam. He refuses to let the genius eat their cuttings because Sabinus would smell it. The plate goes in clean over a scar. Strain: about twenty-six.

Tullus comes down the cage: fifty, grey, one white line above his stripe. 'Line.' Forty-one standing, eighteen down. Rennick touches every tenth from the cage end: a Deep man, Hollen, a transport boy, Bricks; the tenth falls on Jonah, who stood at the end of the decury knowing where it would fall.

Tullus reads the Censor's slate from his coat and says 'Not that one. The galleries. Next.' Rennick's hand moves to Corr. Corr steps out and mouths 'nothing personal'. Sabinus kills the five at the post with the fang.

The Censor: Tullus came to his door at the fourth bell for the galleries' numbers; at the bottom of the slate he wrote that 4471 is the only man on the Shallows who can cut a slab. He spent the one thing he had. A tenth man is a tenth man. 'I would do it again.'

The Censor confesses he drew the Pit twenty-two years ago at a table on Latium: the Throat, the road, the seventh chamber, the Cradle with the sick against the thickest wall called a kindness in the margin, this room, the door. 'Every man on those slabs is on them because I drew the road he walked down.'
Jonah says the names on the road, adds Corr, Auger, Hollen, Bricks and two he does not know, and cannot say the first name on the list. He does not go back to the Cradle for six weeks.

knowledge_changes.fact: The Censor sold Tullus the galleries' numbers with a line naming 4471 as the only slab-cutter on the Shallows, and Corr went to the post in his place.
Sabinus can be made to hurry: steel in a seam takes the boredom off his face and puts fear there; Auger feinted at the feint.
He would last two seconds against Sabinus's water step; he can do half of it.
When the middle is whole the plate goes in clean over the seam; the seam is a scar now.
A decimation is done from the cage end by touching every tenth man; Tullus was trimmed once and decided that day what a number is.
4471 is the only man on the Shallows who can cut a slab, according to the Censor's slate.
4471 crossed a riot unplated to pull a chisel off him and put him under a shelf.
A Collar with a chisel can put steel a finger into his armpit seam.
Tullus struck 4471 off the tenth on the Censor's slate.
The tenth fell on 4471 and Tullus said not that one, and Corr went.
Jonah has left the Cradle and will not come back for a time.

Sabinus can be made to hurry: steel in a seam takes the boredom off his face and puts fear there; Auger feinted at the feint.

thread_beats.description: Auger takes the cage to choose the week; asks for six behind the wall and Decimus off the road; feints at the feint and puts steel in a Centurion's seam; dies. The road becomes the Deep with the slabs cut out.
Jonah does not warn him and hauls him under a shelf unplated through a riot. 'It's my count.' 'Get up, Decimus.'
The water step seen three times; two seconds; half of it done in the dark; the throat seam and the armpit seam by hand memory; a wall that can shed can be made to hurry, shown.
Full plate in the cut; two guards; refuses to eat with Sabinus twenty paces off; plate goes in clean over the scar; about twenty-six.
The seam is a scar: not lying and waiting made the middle whole. He stood at the end of the decury knowing where the tenth would fall.
The slate that saved him cost Corr; and he drew the Pit, the Cradle as a kindness in the margin. 'Now you know what I am, and you can go.'
Corr, Auger, Hollen, Bricks, two unknown. He cannot say the first name on the list.
Tullus seen: trimmed once, grey, decides what a number is. Rennick broken. Sabinus wounded in the armpit and afraid of seams. Forty-one left standing.
Twice more: 'why not', 'you could have told him to be sick', 'that's not an excuse', 'no, it's a number'.
Decimation as the most Roman thing in the Pit, from the library the Roma ark carried.

clues.description: Auger feinted at the feint: he watched the water step three times and put his second hand where it would land.
clues.mechanism: Jonah keeps this and uses it in ch.30: the way to a Centurion's seam is to give him the step he wants.

clues.description: Fear on Sabinus's face, of the seam, kept and thought about for two years.
clues.mechanism: Ch.30: 'Only matter cuts matter.' He lets the fang in to reach the seam.

clues.description: Tullus keeps the Censor's slate in his coat and reads it at the bottom of the Throat in front of the line.
clues.mechanism: Tullus depends on the Chamber; ch.22 when the Censor dies the galleries have no numbers; ch.29 the harvest is rushed.

clues.description: Two dead guards' cuttings left uneaten in the cut with a lamp.
clues.mechanism: Two Tiro loricae unaccounted for in the riot's count; Sabinus will note that no genius ate them and stop looking; later a Flamen will not (ch.25).

clues.description: Rennick's hand stopped a finger from Jonah's shoulder before Tullus spoke.
clues.mechanism: Rennick owes Jonah the weight count and was afraid to touch him; ch.26 the manifest goes through Rennick.

clues.description: Jonah cannot say the first name on the list.
clues.mechanism: Six weeks away; ch.20 he says it again.

clue_resolutions.match: The wall went loud for an hour
Counting by weight: a slab is six
The Censor 'told the man who ordered the galleries
'I built the box, and I am in it.'
Corr says a month to everyone
Auger has seen the wrist-turn twice

character_emotional_states.emotional_state: About twenty-six. Alive because a slate said so and Corr is dead. Cannot say the first name. Six weeks away from the Cradle.
Told the last thing. 'Now you know what I am, and you can go.'
Under a shelf, then at the cage end with his rifle. Hauled through a riot by a Collar.
A finger of steel in his armpit. Not bored.
Read a slate and said not that one.
His voice gone. His hand stopped a finger from a shoulder.
Saw the tenth fall and move.

scenes.summary: The count collapses; fourteen; Sabinus harvests the Deep; Ulli's report.
What a riot is; what a decimation is; stand where the fewest die.
Auger's plan; six behind the wall; Decimus.
The riot: the cage; Sabinus harvesting; Decimus under the shelf; Auger's feint at the feint; the cut in the dark; two guards; plate in clean.
The line; every tenth; not that one; Corr; the post that is not the post.
The slate; Corr's name; I drew the Pit; the names on the road; the first one unsaid.

opening_hook: The Deep stopped giving slabs eleven days after the wall went loud, and the number Jonah built came apart the way a hull does.
closing_hook: He cannot say the first name on the list, and does not go back to the Cradle for six weeks.
notes: Grade about 26. Auger, Corr, Hollen, Bricks dead. Sabinus wounded and afraid of seams. Tullus and Rennick seen. The Censor's design revealed here (moved up from ch.20, which becomes the rupture and return). Two guards' cuttings left uneaten. Decury six is now Jonah, Pell, and four survivors.
